name: Rickey
source:
Rickey is the CEO of Rickeyland, an amusement park in the Vlatyr province, who loves tanks. There, he makes a lot of money by stealing from his customers.

He rides a military tank alongside Runcan and Boyardee to assault Santa's workshop.

[Edited from in-game description]
